moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio cam-crane, written here): Crane up: the camera rises 100 px, so layers move down by 100 px x depth, while the stage tilts 8 deg to look down (rotateX on a perspective parent) with a 10 % push, 2000 ms easeInOutCubic. Demo: camera y +30 -> -40 with a push 1 -> 1.1 over 2.4 s ease-in-out, no tilt drawn. Params: duration (2 s) · rise (100 px) · tilt (8°) · push (10 %).
